data.name: Legion TD 2 - Multiplayer Tower Defense
data.detailed_description:
Outlast your opponent

Waves of enemies attack you and your opponents. Build defenses to survive. Send mercenaries to smash through your opponents' defenses. Scale your economy to become a late game beast. Like Chess, every match is familiar enough to reward game knowledge, but divergent enough to require adaptation.

12 million fighter combinations

Each match, you receive a random roll of 6 fighters, from 12 million possible combinations. Every fighter has strengths & weaknesses. Some secure strategic advantages early game, while others have powerful late-game synergies. Your skill lies in your ability to make the most of the hand you're dealt.

Stable, balanced meta

With 9+ years worth of data-driven, monthly balance patches, Legion TD 2 is perhaps the most balanced competitive game in the world. Rather than introduce disruptive changes every year to shake things up, Legion TD 2 has opted to chase perfecting a healthy meta. If you take a break for a couple years and come back, your same openings will probably still be viable.

Core Features

  • Party as 1-8 players. Play 2v2 and 4v4 matchmade games.

  • Single-player/co-op campaign.* ~8-12 hours, plus 10 levels of AI's.

  • Active playerbase. Fast, fair matches since 2017. Still going strong in 2026.

  • One of a kind gameplay. The only standalone team vs. team competitive tower defense.

Highlights

  • Fun to learn. Dynamic in-game tips and special new-player matchmaking ease you in.

  • Packed with stats. Winrates, pickrates, match histories, leaderboards, top games, and more.

  • Global servers. All multiplayer is cross-region, hosted on our servers.

  • No pay to win. In-game purchases are 100% cosmetic.

  • Behavior system. AFKers, griefers, and toxic players are dealt with quickly.

  • Monthly tournament. $1,000 in prizes every month, hosted on Twitch.

  • Weekly challenges. A puzzle-like competition to find the best build with a set lineup.

*Note: single-player features require an online connection due to technical limitations of the game engine.

History

Legion TD 2 is the sequel to the 2nd most popular Warcraft 3 mod of all time, Legion TD. Also known as Squadron TD in Starcraft 2. The top 5 most played Warcraft 3 mods are DotA, Legion TD, Wintermaul, Footmen Frenzy, and Life of a Peasant. Legion TD is proud to hold the silver medal.

Legion TD 2 launched in early access in 2017, and has received major updates, quality of life, and balance changes every single month since then. After fully launching in October 2021, we believe it has grown to become the most replayable, balanced, competitive strategy experience out there. Unlike other indie multiplayer games, Legion TD 2's playerbase has stood the test of time, having been active & steady for nearly 10 years and counting.

Team

  • Lisk (2014 - Present): Game lead, original Legion TD mod creator

  • Jules (2016 - Present): Game design & balance, business management, and marketing

  • Curing (2018 - 2022): Art director

  • Dani (2019 - Present): Web/dev ops, tools, services, and support

  • Trik (2025 - Present): Lead artist

  • Drachir (2025 - Present): Game dev & design

But the full team goes way beyond us: artists, community staff, tournament organizers & casters, translators, voice actors, and more.

data.short_description: An infinitely replayable multiplayer and single-player tower defense. Defend against waves of enemies and destroy the enemy's king before they destroy yours. Legion TD 2 is a one-of-a-kind game of tactics, teamwork, and prediction. Party as 1-8 players.

data.reviews:
“The basics are simple—build an army, defend your king, eliminate the enemy—but the variety of unique factions and fighters enables a tremendous range of offensive and defensive possibilities.”
PC Gamer

“One of the most popular mods for Warcraft 3 back in the day was Legion TD, a fantastic tower defence game that was second only to the all-powerful DOTA in terms of popularity. ... The popular Warcraft 3 mod Legion TD released around 2009 and inspired both StarCraft II’s Squadron TD and Dota 2’s Legion TD: Reborn – and also possibly autobattlers like Teamfight Tactics and DOTA Underlords.”
PCGamesN

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual core from Intel or AMD at 2.8GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 960 / AMD R9 280X
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection is required for singleplayer & co-op features.

Recommended:

  • Processor: Quad core from Intel or AMd at 2.8GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OS X Mavericks 10.9
  • Processor: Dual core from Intel
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia 320M or higher, or Radeon HD 2400 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Dual core from Intel or AMD at 2.8 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia Geforce 8600/9600GT (Driver v331), AMD HD 2xxx-4xxx (Driver mesa 10.5.9), AMD HD 5xxx+ (Driver mesa 10.5.9 or Catalyst 15.7), Intel HD 3000 (Driver mesa 10.6)

  • Storage: 8 GB available space
